2027 में कर्क राशि के लिए दो बड़े गोचर स: In 2027, two big transits matter most for Cancer — Jupiter and Saturn. From January to June, Jupiter is in your own sign — this adds responsibilities, with restlessness of mind and chances of a change of place. But with Jupiter aspecting the 5th, 7th and 9th houses, it helps in matters of children, marriage and fortune. From 26 June to 26 November, Jupiter in the 2nd house strengthens money, family and speech — income rises, savings grow, with signs of happy family events and stuck money coming back. From 26 November, Jupiter moves into Virgo, the 3rd house from your sign.

From 3 June to 20 October, Saturn in Aries, the 10th house, increases workload and responsibility — slow but solid career progress; honesty in your work is your greatest support.
